thread_analysis.thread_summary: Short internal-consulting thread (handled via Masaya Iida, customer Akihiro Furuhira) about whether changing the accelerometer on a board that also carries a Bluetooth module requires a new application. Allion's first reply incorrectly framed this as a Bluetooth SIG derivative-model question; a follow-up correction message clarified that the customer's actual question was about Japan's Radio Law technical regulation conformity certification (giko sekkei ninsho), a separate domestic certification regime.
all_questions_found: Does changing the accelerometer on the same board as the Bluetooth module require re-application/new registration?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Bluetooth SIG derivative-model rules (free addition if module + Host Stack unchanged) do not apply to Japan's Radio Law technical regulation conformity certification. Under the latter, a supplementary application is required if the swapped part's model name was documented in the original application's parts layout diagram, block diagram, or parts list.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: The deciding factor for whether a component change needs new paperwork depends entirely on which certification system is in scope — Bluetooth SIG (module/Host Stack identity) vs. Japan Radio Law (whether the specific part's model name was in the original filing's documentation).
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Misidentifying the applicable certification framework when answering a component-change question could leave a product non-compliant under Japan's domestic Radio Law even if it remains compliant for Bluetooth SIG purposes.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: Allion's initial reply incorrectly answered the question as if it were about Bluetooth SIG derivative-model rules, when the customer was actually asking about Japan Radio Law technical regulation conformity certification. This was self-caught and corrected within the same day via a follow-up email.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Before answering a 'does this component change require re-application' question, first confirm which certification regime is being asked about (Bluetooth SIG vs. Japan Radio Law technical regulation conformity), since the applicable rule and trigger condition differ completely between the two.
